questions: Did you see the story about the Minneapolis family with the ultra-rare mono mono twins?

conversation_starters.description: Only 1 in 250 pregnancies is identical twins. What's even rarer is something called mono mono twins; those happen in 1 in 10,000 pregnancies. We met a Minneapolis family proving the odds can be against you and with you at the very same time.

you_should_know.title: What we know about allegations against St. Paul Mayor Kaohly Her
you_should_know.summary: Last week, we learned that St. Paul Police Chief Axel Henry had filed a complaint with the city Attorney's office against Mayor Kaohly Her, alleging sexual harassment. (St. Paul is the state capital and twin city just east of Minneapolis, MN.) In a letter, the Chief's Attorney alleges that Mayor Her had sent "inappropriate, and indeed, unlawful text messages" to city staffers. Since then, more allegations have surfaced, including Mayor Her's alleged comments about a Deputy Chief's breasts, as well as photoshopped images of city staffers including police officers. Mayor Her released this statement saying in part-- "I recognize that some of my attempts at humor fell short of the standard I expect of myself." To help sort out what we know, Esme Murphy spoke earlier this morning with Hamline Law Professor David Schultz — Hamline University is a St. Paul school.

you_should_know.summary: A man who introduced himself as Beekey said that he was directed to the encampment at Pig's Eye Park — a large, undeveloped riverside park on the southeast edge of St. Paul, just east of Minneapolis, MN — when he got out of jail about two and a half months ago. He said that this stint behind bars meant that he lost his housing. He's concerned about where he'd end up without the encampment.
